mentions.title: Before You Boil w/ the Campaign for Lead Free Water & FLAC (Hour 1)
mentions.description:
Earl is joined by Paul Schwartz, co-founder of the Campaign for Lead Free Water, and Robert Miranda, executive director of the Freshwater for Life Action Coalition. In today's conversation on the dangers of lead in water, they focus on the necessity of filtering your water, especially if under a boil advisory as boiling water can increase the concentration on lead.
